en.title: Foundational Era
en.subtitle: Attention, BPE tokenization, scaling laws, and early RLHF alignment set the substrate for modern LLMs.

zh.title: 奠基纪元
zh.subtitle: 自注意力机制、分词向量空间、Scaling Laws 与早期 RLHF 对齐奠定了现代大模型底座。

en.title: Generative Breakout
en.subtitle: Prompting, Chain-of-Thought, vector RAG, LoRA quantization, and controllable diffusion go mainstream.

zh.title: 生成式爆发
zh.subtitle: 提示词与思维链、经典向量 RAG、LoRA 量化本地运行与可控扩散图像生成走向普及。

en.title: Structured Tools & Multimodal
en.subtitle: JSON schema tool calling, deterministic graphs, 1M+ context omni models, LLM evals, and ComfyUI pipelines.

zh.title: 结构化工具与原生多模态
zh.subtitle: 结构化输出与工具调用、图编排工作流、百万上下文多模态、系统化评测与 ComfyUI 节点流成型。

en.title: Reasoning, Protocols & Vibe Coding
en.subtitle: RLVR test-time compute (o1/o3/R1), MCP universal tool protocol, vibe coding, browser agents, and hybrid search.

zh.title: 推理强化学习、开放协议与氛围编程
zh.subtitle: RLVR 测试时推理（o1/o3/R1）、MCP 开放协议、Vibe Coding、浏览器操作智能体与混合检索爆发。

en.title: Context, Skills & Agentic Engineering
en.subtitle: Context engineering, CLI coding harnesses, progressive Agent Skills (SKILL.md), subagents, and world models.

zh.title: 上下文工程、技能包与智能体工程化
zh.subtitle: 上下文工程、终端自主编程 Harness、渐进式 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）、并行子智能体与世界模型主导前沿。

en.name: Transformer & Self-Attention
en.oneLiner: Parallel Query-Key-Value routing that replaced recurrence and unlocked massive sequence scaling.
en.paradigmShift: Sequential RNN bottlenecks → parallel QKV attention heads + residual MLP streams.
en.whyNow: Understanding QKV projections and KV caching remains prerequisite to debugging long-context latency and cost.

zh.name: Transformer 与自注意力机制
zh.oneLiner: 用并行 QKV 注意力路由取代循环序列瓶颈，奠定所有现代大语言与多模态模型的计算骨架。
zh.paradigmShift: RNN 串行遗忘瓶颈 → 并行多头注意力 QKV 寻址 + 残差前馈流。
zh.whyNow: 吃透 QKV 矩阵与残差流，仍是今天排查长上下文延迟、KV Cache 显存与注意力退化的必修内功。

en.name: Tokenization & Vector Embeddings
en.oneLiner: Byte-Pair Encoding subword vocabulary and dense geometric representations of semantic meaning.
en.paradigmShift: Brittle character/word dictionaries → BPE token streams + high-dimensional cosine geometry.
en.whyNow: Many LLM arithmetic bugs, multilingual token inflation, and retrieval misses trace straight back to tokenization.

zh.name: 分词器与向量嵌入空间
zh.oneLiner: 通过 BPE 子词切分与高维稠密向量空间，将离散文本与多模态信号映射为可计算的语义几何。
zh.paradigmShift: 脆弱词表与稀疏词袋 → BPE 字节对分词 + 高维余弦语义几何空间。
zh.whyNow: 大模型拼写/算术翻车、中文 Token 计费膨胀与向量召回漂移，根源几乎都在分词器与嵌入分布。

en.name: Scaling Laws & Pre-Training
en.oneLiner: Predictable power-law loss curves across compute, tokens, and parameters during next-token pre-training.
en.paradigmShift: Task-specific supervised models → compute-optimal web-scale next-token world compression.
en.whyNow: Pure pre-training hit high-quality data ceilings, shifting frontier ROI toward synthetic data, MoE, and RLVR.

zh.name: Scaling Laws 与预训练基座
zh.oneLiner: 算力、数据 Token 量与参数规模之间的幂律收敛法则，将海量人类知识压缩进下一词预测基座。
zh.paradigmShift: 单任务监督小模型 → Chinchilla 最优配比的大规模自回归预训练基座。
zh.whyNow: 随天然高质量语料逼近上限，单纯堆预训练转向合成课程数据、MoE 稀疏激活与后训练推理扩展。

en.name: Instruction Tuning & RLHF Alignment
en.oneLiner: Turning raw autocomplete base models into helpful assistants via SFT and human preference reward models.
en.paradigmShift: Unsteerable base completion → SFT + PPO/DPO preference alignment.
en.whyNow: Human-preference RLHF caused sycophancy and reward hacking; verifiable tasks now favor RLVR/GRPO.

zh.name: 指令微调与 RLHF 偏好对齐
zh.oneLiner: 通过监督指令微调（SFT）与人类反馈强化学习，把只会续写的基座模型塑造成遵循指令的对话助手。
zh.paradigmShift: 不可控续写基座 → SFT 指令微调 + PPO/DPO 人类偏好对齐。
zh.whyNow: 纯人类偏好打分易诱发讨好型幻觉（Sycophancy），数学与代码等可验证任务已全面演进至 RLVR/GRPO。

en.name: Prompt Engineering & Chain-of-Thought
en.oneLiner: Few-shot exemplars, role framing, and explicit step-by-step reasoning instructions inside a single prompt.
en.paradigmShift: Zero-shot vague asks → structured delimiters, few-shot pairs, and explicit CoT scratchpads.
en.whyNow: Magic prompt incantations deprecated; reasoning models internalize CoT while multi-turn apps require Context Engineering.

zh.name: 提示词工程与思维链 CoT
zh.oneLiner: 利用少样本示例、XML 结构分隔符与显式分步推理引导，在不改权重的前提下激发模型任务表现。
zh.paradigmShift: 模糊零样本提问 → XML 边界框定 + Few-shot 示例 + 显式思维链推理。
zh.whyNow: 死背“咒语模板”已过时：推理模型已内化思维链，工程重心全面转向多轮动态装配的「上下文工程」。

en.name: Classic RAG & Vector Retrieval
en.oneLiner: Grounding LLM answers in private documents via chunking, dense vector indexing, and top-k injection.
en.paradigmShift: Retraining weights for new facts → external chunk indexing + retrieval-augmented generation.
en.whyNow: Naive fixed-size vector chunking fails on exact IDs and multi-hop queries; pair with BM25, rerankers, and agentic search.

zh.name: 经典 RAG 与向量检索增强
zh.oneLiner: 通过文档切块、向量索引与 Top-K 注入，让大模型基于私有实时知识生成有据可查的回答。
zh.paradigmShift: 靠微调硬塞私有事实 → 外部向量索引 + 检索增强生成。
zh.whyNow: 纯固定长度切片在精确编号与跨段落推理上失召率高，生产环境需升级为 BM25 混合检索 + 重排与 Agentic Search。

en.name: LoRA Fine-Tuning, Quantization & Local LLMs
en.oneLiner: Low-rank adapters (LoRA/QLoRA), 4-bit quantization, and local/self-hosted inference with Ollama and vLLM.
en.paradigmShift: Multi-node H100 full fine-tunes → single-GPU QLoRA + GGUF/vLLM open-weight deployment.
en.whyNow: Distilling frontier trajectories into 4B–32B Qwen/Llama open models via LoRA slashes latency and cost 20x.

zh.name: LoRA 微调、量化与本地开源模型
zh.oneLiner: 借助低秩适应（LoRA/QLoRA）、4-bit 量化与 Ollama/vLLM 推理引擎，在单卡或本地高效微调与部署开源权重。
zh.paradigmShift: 昂贵全量参数训练 → 单卡 Unsloth/QLoRA 微调 + GGUF/vLLM 私有化高吞吐部署。
zh.whyNow: 用前沿大模型轨迹蒸馏 7B–32B 垂直小模型，是 2026 年压降 90% 线上推理成本与满足数据不出域的王牌路径。

en.name: Latent Diffusion & Controllable Image Gen
en.oneLiner: Iterative latent denoising plus spatial conditioning (ControlNet, IP-Adapter, Flux DiT) for art direction.
en.paradigmShift: Random text-to-image slot machines → spatially locked pose, depth, reference, and typography control.
en.whyNow: UNet diffusion evolved into Diffusion Transformers (Flux) and native multimodal image editing with exact text rendering.

zh.name: 潜空间扩散与可控图像生成
zh.oneLiner: 从潜空间逐步去噪生成高保真视觉画面，并结合 ControlNet 姿态/景深与参考图实现商业级精确控图。
zh.paradigmShift: 随机抽卡式文生图 → 骨骼姿态、景深边缘、风格参考与文字排版精准锁定。
zh.whyNow: 底层架构已从 UNet 迭代至扩散 Transformer（Flux）与原生多模态改图，商业落地关键在于一致性控制。

en.name: Structured Outputs & Function Calling
en.oneLiner: Constrained decoding against strict JSON/Pydantic schemas and deterministic API tool invocation.
en.paradigmShift: Fragile regex parsing of markdown replies → grammar-constrained 100% schema-valid JSON & tool calls.
en.whyNow: Every reliable pipeline and agent loop relies on typed tool schemas with concise, unambiguous parameter descriptions.

zh.name: 结构化输出与 Function Calling
zh.shortName: 结构化输出与工具调用
zh.oneLiner: 利用语法约束解码严格输出符合 Pydantic / JSON Schema 的数据，并安全触发外部 API 与数据库调用。
zh.paradigmShift: 正则硬抠 Markdown 文本 → 解码层语法约束 100% 合法 Schema 与类型安全工具调用。
zh.whyNow: 无论上层用不用框架，精心设计工具参数边界与错误返回格式，始终是 Agent 稳定率最高杠杆的一步。

en.name: Deterministic Workflows vs Graph Agents
en.oneLiner: Chaining, routing, evaluator-optimizer patterns, and stateful graph orchestration for bounded business tasks.
en.paradigmShift: Unbounded 2023 AutoGPT loops → explicit prompt chains, routers, and checkpointed state graphs.
en.whyNow: Over-engineered 30-node DAGs break easily; stronger 2026 models favor simple tool-use while-loops + modular Skills.

zh.name: 确定性工作流与状态图编排
zh.oneLiner: 区分确定性链式路由（Workflows）与自主智能体，用状态图检查点与评估-优化循环控制生产风险。
zh.paradigmShift: 2023 失控死循环 AutoGPT → 显式路由链、并行扇出与带断点恢复的状态图。
zh.whyNow: 过度复杂的几十节点死板连线正在退潮；随着模型能力跃升，主流工程收敛为「极简工具循环 + 按需加载 Skills」。

en.name: 1M+ Long Context & Native Omni Multimodal
en.oneLiner: FlashAttention, Ring Attention, prompt caching, and unified vision-audio-document reasoning in one model.
en.paradigmShift: 4K token blindfolds + separate OCR/ASR glue → cached million-token context & native PDF/video/voice intake.
en.whyNow: Having a 1M window does not prevent 'context rot'; combine prompt caching with active context pruning.

zh.name: 百万长上下文与原生多模态
zh.oneLiner: 依托 FlashAttention、上下文缓存与原生视觉/音频编码，让单模型直接吞吐整本代码库、PDF 图表与长视频。
zh.paradigmShift: 4K 窗口截断 + 拼凑 OCR/语音转写 → 百万级 Prompt Caching + 原生图文音视频端到端理解。
zh.whyNow: 窗口变大不等于“塞得越满越聪明”：超过有效阈值会出现注意力腐化（Context Rot），必须配合上下文裁剪。

en.name: LLM Evals, Trace Analysis & Judge Pipelines
en.oneLiner: Systematic error analysis on real production traces, binary pass/fail criteria, and aligned LLM-as-a-Judge.
en.paradigmShift: Eyeballing 3 cherry-picked examples ('vibe checks') → axial trace coding + automated regression eval suites.
en.whyNow: Evals are the #1 moat separating toy demos from compounding production AI teams whenever models or prompts change.

zh.name: 大模型评测体系与链路可观测性
zh.oneLiner: 从真实线上 Trace 做开放式错误归因，建立二元通过/失败准则与对齐人类专家的 LLM-as-a-Judge 回归集。
zh.paradigmShift: 拍脑袋肉眼试 3 条（Vibe Check）→ 真实坏例分类统计 + 自动化 CI 评测飞轮。
zh.whyNow: 模型每季度升级、Prompt 一改就牵一发动全身，只有先搭好专属业务 Eval 集，团队才敢高频迭代。

en.name: ComfyUI Node Graphs & Multimodal Video/Audio
en.oneLiner: Reproducible node-graph pipelines chaining Flux keyframes, camera-controlled DiT video, and expressive voice.
en.paradigmShift: One-off web UI prompts → versioned JSON node workflows locking character identity, lighting, and lip-sync.
en.whyNow: Production studios lock first/last keyframes in Flux/ComfyUI before driving DiT video generation to eliminate drift.

zh.name: ComfyUI 节点流与可控音视频创作
zh.oneLiner: 用可复用的节点图串联 Flux 首尾帧锁脸、运镜可控视频生成与高表现力语音克隆，打造工业化多模态管线。
zh.paradigmShift: 单次网页盲盒抽卡 → 首尾关键帧锁定 + 镜头运动控制 + 可版本化复用的 ComfyUI 工作流。
zh.whyNow: “先用生图锁死角色与构图，再首尾帧驱动视频与配音对口型”已成为 2026 短片、电商视觉与动画团队的标准 SOP。

en.name: MCP: Model Context Protocol
en.oneLiner: The USB-C open standard connecting AI clients and coding agents to external tools, databases, and OAuth APIs.
en.paradigmShift: N×M custom API connectors per host app → one reusable MCP server across Claude, Cursor, Codex, and IDEs.
en.whyNow: Avoid mounting 50 noisy MCP tools at once; expose lean domain actions and pair MCP connectivity with progressive Skills.

zh.name: MCP 模型上下文开放协议
zh.oneLiner: 连接大模型客户端与外部数据库、SaaS 及本地工具的「USB-C 开放标准」，一次实现跨宿主通用挂载。
zh.paradigmShift: 每个应用重复造 N×M 套插件胶水 → 标准 MCP Server 跨 Claude、Cursor、Codex 即插即用。
zh.whyNow: 2026 关键避坑：切忌一次性挂载几十个高啰嗦度 MCP 塞满上下文，应精简原子接口并配合 Skills 按需唤醒。

en.name: Test-Time Compute & RLVR Reasoning (o1/o3/R1)
en.oneLiner: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (GRPO) scaling inference-time thinking, backtracking, and tool use.
en.paradigmShift: Fixed single-pass token budget → RL on verifiable unit tests/math + dynamic test-time thinking budgets.
en.whyNow: Interleaved thinking + tool calls (search/bash mid-chain) made multi-step coding and research agents finally reliable.

zh.name: 测试时计算与 RLVR 推理模型
zh.oneLiner: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR / GRPO）与测试时计算扩展，让模型自主涌现长链推演、自我纠错与工具交错思考。
zh.paradigmShift: 固定算力直觉秒回 → 代码单测/数学真值强化学习 + 推理期动态思考预算（o1/o3/DeepSeek-R1）。
zh.whyNow: 「边思考边调工具（Interleaved Thinking）」直接解锁了复杂代码库排障与深度多跳研究能力的质变。

en.name: Vibe Coding & Zero-to-One Prototyping
en.oneLiner: Coined by Karpathy in early 2025: steering LLMs in natural language to spin up throwaway apps and interactive UIs fast.
en.paradigmShift: Manual boilerplate scaffolding → conversational accept-all rapid UI & weekend prototype generation.
en.whyNow: Pure unreviewed vibe coding hits a wall on security and >5k LOC debt; production teams graduated to Agentic Engineering.

zh.name: Vibe Coding 氛围编程与极速原型
zh.oneLiner: Karpathy 于 2025 初提出的自然语言直觉造物方式：把语法细节交给模型，一天跑通可交互原型与个人小工具。
zh.paradigmShift: 手敲样板脚手架 → 自然语言口述需求、快速试错跑通 0→1 可交互产品原型。
zh.whyNow: 不看代码的纯 Vibe Coding 在鉴权安全与上万行维护上极易崩盘；生产研发已进阶为有测试闭环的「智能体工程化」。

en.name: Computer Use & Browser Action Agents
en.oneLiner: Agents combining accessibility trees, Playwright DOM snapshots, and pixel grounding to operate real web UIs.
en.paradigmShift: Brittle CSS-selector RPA scripts → semantic DOM + visual verification loops inside isolated sandboxes.
en.whyNow: Essential for end-to-end visual QA and legacy portals without APIs, always gated behind human approval for writes.

zh.name: Computer Use 与浏览器操作智能体
zh.oneLiner: 结合无障碍树（AXTree）、Playwright 快照与视觉坐标定位，让智能体在隔离沙盒中真实点击、填表与视觉巡检。
zh.paradigmShift: 页面一改版就挂的死板 RPA 脚本 → 语义快照 + 视觉自校验闭环浏览器智能体。
zh.whyNow: 已成为前端自动化视觉验收与无 API 老旧后台集成的标配能力，但高危写操作与登录边界必须保留人工确认。

en.name: Hybrid Retrieval, GraphRAG & Agentic Search
en.oneLiner: Combining lexical grep/BM25, dense vectors, cross-encoder rerankers, and iterative query rewriting by the model.
en.paradigmShift: Single-shot top-5 cosine lookup → multi-step agentic search (`grep` + BM25 + vector + ColPali visual pages).
en.whyNow: Claude Code proved that fast lexical `ripgrep` + agentic file navigation often beats complex vector pipelines on code/docs.

zh.name: 混合检索、GraphRAG 与 Agentic Search
zh.oneLiner: 融合精确词法检索（BM25/ripgrep）、向量召回、Cross-Encoder 重排与智能体多轮改写追问的高精度知识架构。
zh.paradigmShift: 单次 Top-5 向量盲搜 → 词法+语义混合召回 + 智能体自主改写查询多跳深挖。
zh.whyNow: 2025–2026 最重要实战认知：在代码与结构化文档上，极速 `grep` + 目录树导航往往比盲目上重型向量库更准更稳。

en.name: Context Engineering & Memory Compaction
en.oneLiner: The art and systems engineering of filling the context window with just the right state, tools, and compacted history.
en.paradigmShift: Tweaking static system-prompt adjectives → dynamic context assembly, observation masking, compaction & subagent isolation.
en.whyNow: Endorsed by Karpathy, Lutke, and Anthropic as the true successor to Prompt Engineering for long-horizon agents.

zh.name: 上下文工程与记忆压缩架构
zh.oneLiner: 在每一步推理前精准组装状态、按需检索、裁剪冗长工具日志并做轨迹压缩（Compaction）的系统工程学科。
zh.paradigmShift: 抠静态提示词措辞 → 动态上下文装配、工具输出截断、轨迹摘要压缩与子智能体上下文隔离。
zh.whyNow: 获 Karpathy、Tobi Lütke 与 Anthropic 共同定调为「提示词工程的真正继任者」，决定长程 Agent 成败的第一分水岭。

en.name: Agentic Coding CLI & Repository Harnesses
en.oneLiner: Terminal-native coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agents) anchored by `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`, tests, and git worktrees.
en.paradigmShift: Tab-autocomplete inside one file → plan-edit-test-fix loops across full repos in isolated git worktrees.
en.whyNow: Giving the agent fast deterministic verification (`typecheck`, unit tests, Playwright) turns LLMs into self-correcting engineers.

zh.name: 自主编程终端与仓库 Harness 工程
zh.oneLiner: 以 Claude Code、Codex 与 Cursor Agent 为代表，靠 `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` 规范、自动化测试与 Git Worktree 闭环交付工程变更。
zh.paradigmShift: 单文件 Tab 补全 → 「先规划 → 多文件修改 → 跑单测/类型检查自愈 → 提 PR」的仓库级闭环工程。
zh.whyNow: 决定研发提效上限的不再是换哪个编辑器，而是给 Agent 配齐极速确定性校验脚本与清晰的仓库架构约束文件。

en.name: Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`) & Subagent Harnesses
en.oneLiner: Filesystem-based progressive capability folders (`SKILL.md` + scripts) paired with isolated subagent contexts and bash sandboxes.
en.paradigmShift: Dumping 40k tokens of MCP schemas upfront → 50-token skill metadata index + on-demand `SKILL.md` & script execution.
en.whyNow: The hottest 2026 agent architecture pattern: portable `SKILL.md` playbooks + sandboxed bash + scoped subagents.

zh.name: Agent Skills 技能体系与子智能体隔离
zh.oneLiner: 以文件系统 `SKILL.md` + 脚本资源包实现「三级渐进式按需加载」，配合独立上下文子智能体与安全沙盒执行复杂长任务。
zh.paradigmShift: 开局硬塞几万 Token 工具定义 → 首屏仅读轻量目录摘要，命中任务再按需挂载 `SKILL.md` 与执行脚本。
zh.whyNow: 2026 最核心的智能体架构收敛方向：跨工具可移植的 `SKILL.md` 标准 + 沙盒 Bash + 子智能体上下文分治。

en.name: World Models, Spatial Intelligence & VLA
en.oneLiner: Interactive 3D physics-consistent world simulators and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models bridging pixels to physical control.
en.paradigmShift: 1D token prediction without 3D physics → navigable world state simulation & embodied action policies.
en.whyNow: The frontier beyond text LLMs: interactive video worlds, persistent 3D scenes, and general-purpose robotics policies.

zh.name: 世界模型、空间智能与具身 VLA
zh.oneLiner: 具备三维物理一致性与因果状态推演的交互式世界模拟器，以及连接视觉感知与物理控制的具身 VLA 模型。
zh.paradigmShift: 缺乏三维物理常识的一维文本预测 → 可交互 3D 空间状态模拟与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）具身控制。
zh.whyNow: 文本大模型之后的下一座主峰：正在重塑游戏可交互世界生成、影视虚拟制片与通用机器人策略训练。
